items.message: Areas most at risk include low lying areas in Tetbury, Badminton, Brook End at Luckington, Corsham, Lacock and the road at Reybridge. Further flooding is possible overnight and on Friday in response to recent and forecast rain this evening.

items.description: Tributaries on the Upper River Thames above Cricklade
items.message:
High river levels this afternoon may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible from overnight on Thursday 19 November .
Flooding of low lying land and roads is expected, especially along the Swill Brook. Further light rainfall is forecast over the next 24 hours. We expect river levels to remain high overnight.
We are closely monitoring the situation .
Avoid using low lying footpaths and any bridges near local watercourses.  
This message will be updated by 9:30AM on Friday 20 November or as the situation changes.
items.river_or_sea: Flagham Brook, Swill Brook, Hankerton Brook, Hykemeres Stream, Derry Brook, River Key

items.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding, though standing water and debris may still remain.
Further rainfall is forecast. 
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.  
Continue to take care on waterside roads and footpaths and don't put yourself in unnecessary danger.
